description.value: Yolks is a scratch-cooking breakfast and brunch chain founded by Chef Steve Ewing, with its Davie Street location sitting in Vancouver's West End. The restaurant is known for Perfectly Poached™ eggs, house-made hollandaise, truffle lemon potatoes, and free-range eggs sourced from Coligny Creek in Abbotsford. Indoor-only seating and a community-focused ethos make it a reliable full-meal stop for cyclists passing through central Vancouver.
